scope: Account-approved native device session issuance, authentication, service API access, one-time consumption, and revocation
environment: Local Cloudflare Worker/D1 integration through Miniflare with synthetic gateway account identities, plus Android-independent Core tests on a local JVM

implementation.authorizationFlow: device code + user code; browser approval binds the pending request to the signed-in Rockstar owner
implementation.tokenStorage: SHA-256 token hashes only; clear token returned once after atomic authorization consumption
implementation.revocation: owner-authenticated session listing and immediate per-session revocation
deviceSessionApis: Sky A2A agent discovery and connection management
A2A delegation create/read/update and artifact/settlement reads
remote LLM request and estimate authentication guard
implementation.coreClientProtocol: android/core/src/main/java/dev/rock/core/platform/RockstarDeviceAuthorizationFlow.java; injected HTTPS transport and protected session-store interfaces only

androidClientSource.transport: android/automation/src/main/java/dev/rock/automation/AndroidRockstarDeviceAuthorizationTransport.java; exact-origin HTTPS, redirects rejected, bounded JSON and timeouts
androidClientSource.sessionStore: android/automation/src/main/java/dev/rock/automation/AndroidRockstarDeviceSessionStore.java; no-backup AES-GCM ciphertext under AndroidKeyStore key
androidClientSource.userFlow: RockShellService + Shell AIDL v6 + MainActivity code/approval/poll UI
androidClientSource.serviceOrigin: Build-time rockstarServiceOrigin; no default production endpoint
androidClientSource.limitedCompile: Transport and storage Java sources compiled with javac 11 against temporary Android API stubs; not a substitute for Android SDK compilation or runtime

verification.result: PASS (local synthetic Worker/D1 and Android-independent Core JVM protocol tests)
deviceFlowCases: authorization request generates an eight-character user code and 256-bit device code
signed-in browser sees the requesting device name
approved device receives a one-time 90-day bearer session, with only its SHA-256 hash persisted
expired user codes and expired device sessions are rejected
replayed polling cannot retrieve the token again
bearer session resolves the same account through the shared requestUser helper for entitlement, Sky agent, and Zema work APIs
account holder can list sessions without exposing token material and revoke the session
coreProtocolCases: browser approval and one-time polling stores the token exactly once through the injected session-store seam
device name, origin, verification URLs, response schema, code shapes, and token expiry are validated
pending, slow_down, denial, expiry, and too-early polling are handled without leaking credentials

notProven: Android source compilation, runtime HTTPS/TLS and Keystore behavior, APK build, Binder/AIDL/device-link acceptance on a supported device
AndroidKeyStore attestation and server registration of the separate A2A Broker signing key
production identity provider behavior, deployment, rate limiting, carrier activation, SIM/eSIM fulfillment, or production billing
notes: Local gateway identities are synthetic and do not authenticate a real person or account.
The device session authorizes existing service APIs but does not bypass service entitlement scopes, price quotes, budgets, or provider receipt verification.
